traits.name: Charismatic
traits.effect: On a Persuade (Personality) test, you may reroll one d20 once. Accept the new result.

traits.name: Counsellor
traits.effect: On a Psychology (Intelligence) test, you may reroll one d20 once. Accept the new result.

traits.name: First-Aider
traits.effect: On a Medicine (Intelligence) test, you may reroll one d20 once. Accept the new result.

traits.name: Flying Ace
traits.effect: On a Spacecraft (Coordination) test, you may reroll one d20 once. Accept the new result.

traits.name: Graceful
traits.effect: On an Acrobatics (Agility) test, you may reroll one d20 once. Accept the new result.

traits.name: Influencer
traits.effect: On a Lifestyle (Personality) test, you may reroll one d20 once. Accept the new result.

traits.name: Misdirection
traits.effect: On a Thievery (Awareness) test, you may reroll one d20 once. Accept the new result.

traits.name: Pattern Recognition
traits.effect: On an Analysis (Awareness) test, you may reroll one d20 once. Accept the new result.

traits.name: Pedal to the Metal
traits.effect: On a Pilot (Coordination) test, you may reroll one d20 once. Accept the new result.

traits.name: Professional
traits.effect: On a Command (Personality) test, you may reroll one d20 once. Accept the new result.

traits.name: Resilient
traits.effect: On a Close Combat (Agility) test, you may reroll one d20 once. Accept the new result.

traits.name: Scout
traits.effect: On a Stealth (Agility) test, you may reroll one d20 once. Accept the new result.

traits.name: Sharp Senses
traits.effect: On an Observation (Awareness) test, you may reroll one d20 once. Accept the new result.

traits.name: Specialist
traits.effect: On a Science (Intelligence) test, you may reroll one d20 once. Accept the new result.

traits.name: Speed Typing
traits.effect: On a Hacking (Intelligence) test, you may reroll one d20 once. Accept the new result.

traits.name: Stubborn
traits.effect: On a Discipline (Willpower) test, you may reroll one d20 once. Accept the new result.

traits.name: Sturdy
traits.effect: On a Resistance (Brawn) test, you may reroll one d20 once. Accept the new result.

traits.name: Technician
traits.effect: On a Tech (Intelligence) test, you may reroll one d20 once. Accept the new result.

traits.name: Tracker
traits.effect: On a Survival (Awareness) test, you may reroll one d20 once. Accept the new result.

traits.name: Trigger Happy
traits.effect: On a Ballistics (Coordination) test, you may reroll one d20 once. Accept the new result.

traits.name: Wild Empathy
traits.effect: On an Animal Handling (Personality) test, you may reroll one d20 once. Accept the new result.

traits.name: Wild Guess
traits.effect: On an Education (Intelligence) test, you may reroll one d20 once. Accept the new result.

traits.name: Zero-Gravity
traits.effect: On an Extraplanetary (Awareness) test, you may reroll one d20 once. Accept the new result.

traits.name: Anti Virus
traits.effect: When an Infowar attack would inflict a Firewall Wound, spend 1 Momentum to halve the attack's Firewall damage (round down), then determine Wounds normally.

traits.name: Automatic Reaction Order (ARO)
traits.effect: Reaction: when an enemy leaves your immediate range (5 ft), spend 1 Momentum to attempt a CC or BS attack if eligible. On success, deal normal damage and stop that movement.

traits.name: Blending in
traits.effect: Gain +1 Stealth skill point. On a Stealth test, you may reroll all failed d20s once; accept the new results.

traits.name: Combat Analysis
traits.effect: Minor Action: make a D1 Analysis test during combat. On success, identify one special ability, hidden item or technological advantage of an opponent. Spend 1 Momentum per additional detail.

traits.name: Courageous
traits.effect: When you would gain Frightened, spend 1 Momentum to ignore that instance of the condition.

traits.name: Dumb Luck
traits.effect: Once per encounter, spend 1 Momentum after rolling a skill check to reroll up to two failed d20s. Accept the new results.

traits.name: Damage Resistance
traits.effect: When damaged by an attack, spend 1 Momentum to reduce the damage by 1d6, to a minimum of 0.

traits.name: Impetuous
traits.effect: Once per round on your turn, spend 1 Momentum to take one extra Standard Action. Does not stack with Tactical Awareness.

traits.name: Rigorous Training
traits.effect: Gain 1 bonus Momentum on each successful Athletics test.

traits.name: Risk Taker
traits.effect: Once per encounter, after a successful damaging attack, treat its damage dice as maximum values. Whenever you fail a skill check, lose 1 Momentum (minimum 0).

traits.name: Wild Card
traits.effect: At the start of an encounter, add 1 Heat to the GM pool to let your side act first, subject to GM adjudication of surprise.

traits.name: Aerial Trooper
traits.effect: With a functioning jetpack, make a Pilot test to deploy by air at an eligible location when combat starts; use the scatter template if needed. During combat, you may fly up to 10 ft above the ground.

traits.name: Dogged
traits.effect: If reduced to 0 HP without immediate death, you may ignore Unconscious for the rest of the encounter. At the start of each of your turns at 0 HP, roll 1d20; a natural 20 kills you. Shocked still causes immediate death. If still at 0 HP when the encounter ends, become Unconscious.

traits.name: Bio Immunity
traits.effect: Ignore Poisoned. Viral ammunition deals normal damage to you without its poison effect.

traits.name: Brutal Critical
traits.effect: On a subskill test, a natural 1 or a natural roll exactly equal to the skill target counts as a critical success (two successes). The latter is an exception to the normal under-target rule. A die cannot count as more than two successes; main-skill checks gain no expanded critical range.

traits.name: Brutality
traits.effect: When you attack a target, it must pass a D1 Psychology test or become Frightened. Resolve at most once per target per round.

traits.name: Cammo - TO 1
traits.effect: Gain +2d20 on Stealth tests using functioning TO camouflage. On success, gain Invisible. Gain +1 Discipline skill point on acquisition. Requires Cammo - Normal.

traits.name: Chain of command
traits.effect: When your officer becomes Unconscious or Dead, you may temporarily assume their Officer Talent for the encounter. Do not gain its permanent skill points or refresh spent orders.

traits.name: Combat Instinct
traits.effect: You are immune to the Surprised condition.

traits.name: Counter Intelligence
traits.effect: Once per long rest, automatically pass one skill check against a target. Gain no Momentum from that check.

traits.name: Defensive Play
traits.effect: When defending against an attack, you may use Close Combat against melee attacks or Acrobatics against ranged attacks instead of main-skill Agility.

traits.name: Eagle Eye
traits.effect: Reduce Difficulty by 1 on Observation or Ballistics tests involving sniping.

traits.name: Damage Resistance (Total)
traits.effect: When damaged by an attack, reduce damage by 1d6 (minimum 0). Each 6 explodes: roll another d6 and add it. Requires Damage Resistance; this replaces that Trait’s reduction.

traits.name: Hard to Kill
traits.effect: When your HP reaches 0, spend 1 Momentum to recover 1d6 HP before applying Unconscious. Cannot prevent immediate death, including Shocked. Once per triggering attack.

traits.name: Imposing Figure
traits.effect: Once per encounter, as a Standard Action, confront hostile targets within the circle template. Each must pass a D1 Psychology test or become Frightened and move away when able.

traits.name: Linked with the AI (Note: Free for Enhanced Humans)
traits.effect: Reduce Difficulty by 1 on Tech, Hacking or Analysis tests. You may be targeted by eligible hacking attacks. Free for Enhanced Humans.

traits.name: Linked with the EI (Note: Free for ALF or any Combined army factions)
traits.effect: Reduce Difficulty by 2 on Tech, Hacking or Analysis tests. You may be targeted by eligible hacking attacks. Free for ALF or Combined Army faction members.

traits.name: Lucky
traits.effect: Before each session, roll 1d6 to determine your uses of Lucky. Spend one use after rolling to reroll one failed d20 on a skill check. Accept the new result. Unused uses expire at session end; long rests do not refresh them.

traits.name: Medical Expert
traits.effect: Once per encounter, when using a Health Kit to restore HP to yourself or an ally, restore an additional 2d6 HP (up to maximum). Requires Medicine - Medic, Medicine - Doctor or Medicine - Doctor+.

traits.name: Mimetism
traits.effect: When targeted by a ranged attack requiring line of sight, add 1 Heat to the GM pool to gain +1d20 on your defensive test. Alternatively, reroll one failed d20 on that defence for 1 Heat. Choose only one option per attack.

traits.name: Born Leader
traits.effect: Once per long rest, automatically pass a Command test; gain no Momentum from that check.

traits.name: Regeneration (NOTE: for AI, Neo Humans and ALF only)
traits.effect: Once per encounter, at the start of one of your turns while conscious, recover 1d6 HP, up to your maximum. Requires AI, Neo Human or ALF.

traits.name: Religious Troop
traits.effect: Reduce Difficulty by 1 on checks to resist Frightened or Stressed. Free for Haqqislam characters.

traits.name: Resistance (Shock)
traits.effect: Reduce Difficulty by 1 on checks to resist Shocked or a Shock attack’s special effect.

traits.name: Resistance (Viral)
traits.effect: Reduce Difficulty by 1 on checks to resist Poisoned from viral attacks.

traits.name: Sixth Sense
traits.effect: Reduce Difficulty by 1 on defensive or surprise checks against surprise attacks. If an attack catches you off guard, you may add 1 Heat to reroll one failed d20 on that defence.

traits.name: Strategist
traits.effect: Before an encounter, roll 1d20 and record its value. Once during the encounter, subtract it from one of your own rolled skill-test d20 results (minimum 1). Use the adjusted result only for ordinary success; it cannot create a critical or Focus success, and cannot remove a natural-20 complication.

traits.name: Strong Grip
traits.effect: You cannot be forcibly disarmed or made to drop a held item unless you choose to release it.

traits.name: Stunning Presence
traits.effect: When you attack a target, it must pass a D1 Psychology test or become Stunned. Resolve at most once per target per round. Free for Odalisques.

traits.name: Super Jump
traits.effect: You may jump up to twice your base Brawn score in feet, using the normal Athletics (Brawn) jump action.

traits.name: Superior Tactics
traits.effect: Reduce Difficulty by 1 on skill checks to execute surprise attacks.

traits.name: Tactical Awareness
traits.effect: Once per round on your turn, take one extra Standard Action. This does not stack with the extra action from Impetuous.

traits.name: Terrain Expert
traits.effect: Reduce Difficulty by 1 on skill tests involving terrain.

traits.name: Total Reaction
traits.effect: Reaction: when an enemy in line of sight attacks you, spend 1 Momentum to oppose the attack with an eligible CC or BS attack. Resolve using the workbook’s Face Off rule. You may add 1 Heat for +1d20 to this reaction, once per reaction.

traits.name: Total Regeneration (NOTE: for AI, Neo Humans and ALF only)
traits.effect: Once per encounter, at the start of one of your turns while conscious, recover 1d6 HP, up to your maximum. Each 6 explodes: roll another d6 and add it. Requires Regeneration and replaces its effect.

traits.name: Veteran
traits.effect: Ignore penalties caused by your officer being incapacitated, lost or out of range.

traits.name: Weapon Master
traits.effect: When you make a successful Close Combat attack, each Momentum spent on bonus damage adds 2d6 instead of 1d6.

traits.name: All Terrain Expert
traits.effect: Reduce Difficulty by 2 on terrain-related skill tests. Requires Terrain Expert; replaces its reduction.

traits.name: Cammo - TO 2
traits.effect: Gain +3d20 on Stealth tests using functioning TO camouflage. On success, gain Invisible. Gain +1 Survival skill point on acquisition. Requires Cammo - TO 1; replaces its dice bonus.

traits.name: Unshakable
traits.effect: Reduce Difficulty by 2 on checks to resist Frightened or Stressed.

traits.name: Fast Healer
traits.effect: After each long rest, remove half your current physical Wounds (round down) without medical attention.

traits.name: Fatality
traits.effect: After a successful Close Combat attack and damage resolution, a target with fewer than 5 HP remaining dies.

traits.name: Immunity (Total)
traits.effect: Treat special ammunition as normal damage; ignore its ammunition-specific saving checks and secondary effects. Ordinary damage still applies.

traits.name: Night Vision
traits.effect: See in low light and darkness up to 60 ft.

traits.name: Non-Hackable
traits.effect: You cannot be targeted by hacking attacks restricted to specific eligible unit types (e.g. HI, Pilot or TAG). Other applicable Infowar attacks remain possible.

traits.name: Enhanced (Meta Humans only)
traits.effect: Once per session, select one purchased or purchasable Trait for which you meet all prerequisites and species/faction restrictions, excluding Enhanced and other bestowed-only Traits. Use it for one encounter. Do not select it again until all eligible choices have been used.

traits.name: Fanatic (Only for the members of the Hassassin Bahram or any valuable affiliates that was bestowed by the Imam.)
traits.effect: If you have a Cube and would die from HP loss, become Unconscious instead, unless Shocked or your Cube is destroyed. A Medic or Doctor may revive a functional body or transfer the intact Cube to a prepared body. Requires eligible Hassassin Bahram membership or Imam-bestowed affiliation.

traits.name: Formation (for fireteam talent only)
traits.effect: While linked with your fireteam within 10 ft, gain 360-degree vision and immunity to Surprised. Requires Fire Team Member or higher.

traits.name: Mnemonica (only for ALF or any Combined Army faction members)
traits.effect: Once only, when you die, transfer your consciousness and skill attributes into a preselected compatible, consenting friendly host. Requires ALF or Combined Army faction membership; GM confirms host compatibility. Keep the chosen host private until activation.

traits.name: Cammo - Normal
traits.effect: Gain +1d20 on Stealth tests while using functioning camouflage. On success, gain Hidden, not Invisible. Prerequisite for Cammo - TO 1.

talents.name: Animal Handler
talents.effect: Gain +1d20 on Animal Handling tests involving a companion. Control up to 1 companion.

talents.name: Pack Ranger
talents.effect: Gain +2d20 on Animal Handling tests involving companions. Control up to 2 companions. Once per round, use a Free Action to order one companion to attack.

talents.name: Pack Leader
talents.effect: Gain +3d20 on Animal Handling tests involving companions. Control up to 3 companions. Once per round, use a Free Action to order one companion to attack.

talents.name: Rock Climber
talents.effect: Climb up to your movement speed as a Free Action. Gain +1d20 on Acrobatics tests to climb structures.

talents.name: Mountain Climber
talents.effect: Gain +2d20 on Acrobatics tests to climb structures. You may fire a small weapon while climbing.

talents.name: Climbing Expert
talents.effect: Gain +3d20 on Acrobatics tests to climb structures. If rigged securely, you may fire a medium weapon while climbing.

talents.name: Naval Diver
talents.effect: Gain +1d20 on applicable tests while performing activities underwater.

talents.name: Combat Diver
talents.effect: Gain +2d20 on applicable tests while performing activities underwater.

talents.name: Diving Specialist
talents.effect: Gain +3d20 on applicable tests while performing activities underwater.

talents.name: Paratrooper
talents.effect: Gain +1d20 on tests for combat jumps.

talents.name: Combat Jumper
talents.effect: Gain +1d20 on tests for combat jumps. You may fight during the jump.

talents.name: Drop Zone Specialist
talents.effect: Gain +1d20 on tests for combat jumps. After dropping into enemy territory, gain +5 to your Stealth target until discovered.

talents.name: Counter Intelligence
talents.effect: Gain +1d20 on Intelligence-related skill tests.

talents.name: Espionage
talents.effect: Gain +2d20 on Intelligence-related skill tests.

talents.name: Spy
talents.effect: Gain +3d20 on Intelligence-related skill tests.

talents.name: Demolition Expert - Level 1
talents.effect: Gain +1d20 on sabotage or demolition tests when using a D-Charge unit.

talents.name: Demolition Expert - Level 2
talents.effect: Gain +2d20 on sabotage or demolition tests when using a D-Charge unit.

talents.name: Demolition Expert - Level 3
talents.effect: Gain +3d20 on sabotage or demolition tests when using a D-Charge unit.

talents.name: Engineer Level 1
talents.effect: Gain +1d20 on tests to repair structures or recover an allied TAG/remote’s Firewall.

talents.name: Engineer Level 2
talents.effect: Gain +2d20 on tests to repair structures or recover an allied TAG/remote’s Firewall; +1d20 to recover a person’s Firewall.

talents.name: Engineer Level 3
talents.effect: Gain +3d20 on tests to repair structures or recover an allied TAG/remote’s Firewall; +2d20 to recover a person’s Firewall.

talents.name: Fire Team Member
talents.effect: Gain +1d20 on Ballistics tests while in linked formation. Gain the Formation Trait.

talents.name: Fire Team Leader
talents.effect: Gain +2d20 on Ballistics tests while in formation and +5 to your Agility target when defending against ranged attacks.

talents.name: Fire Team Master
talents.effect: Gain +3d20 on Ballistics tests while in formation and +10 to your Agility target when defending against ranged attacks.

talents.name: Forward Observer
talents.effect: While you have line of sight to a target within 60 ft, you may relay targeting information to allies, including hackers, so they can use your sightline where their attack or hacking method permits it.

talents.name: Forward Analyst
talents.effect: While you have line of sight to a target within 100 ft, you may relay targeting information to allies, including hackers, so they can use your sightline where their attack or hacking method permits it.

talents.name: Forward Signaler
talents.effect: While you have line of sight to a target within 200 ft, you may relay targeting information to allies, including hackers, so they can use your sightline where their attack or hacking method permits it.

talents.name: Gunner
talents.effect: Gain +1d20 on Ballistics tests with heavy firearms.

talents.name: Gunnery Sergeant
talents.effect: Gain +2d20 on Ballistics tests with heavy firearms. Ignore penalties specifically for operating heavy firearms.

talents.name: Gunnery Sergeant Major
talents.effect: Gain +3d20 on Ballistics tests with heavy firearms. Ignore penalties specifically for operating heavy firearms.

talents.name: Hacker Level 1
talents.effect: Gain +1d20 on Hacking tests involving software or hardware.

talents.name: Hacker Level 2
talents.effect: Gain +2d20 on Hacking tests involving software or hardware; +1d20 on hacking attacks against a person.

talents.name: Hacker Level 3
talents.effect: Gain +3d20 on Hacking tests involving software or hardware; +2d20 on hacking attacks against a person.

talents.name: Impersonation - Mimetism
talents.effect: Gain +1d20 on Persuade tests to impersonate a human. This talent does not permit impersonation of other species.

talents.name: Impersonation Level 1
talents.effect: Gain +2d20 on Persuade tests to impersonate a human, or +1d20 to impersonate another species.

talents.name: Impersonation Level 2
talents.effect: Gain +3d20 on Persuade tests to impersonate a human, or +2d20 to impersonate another species.

talents.name: Marksman Level 1
talents.effect: Gain +1d20 on Ballistics tests when firing a firearm.

talents.name: Marksman Level 2
talents.effect: Gain +2d20 on Ballistics tests when firing a firearm.

talents.name: Marksman Level 3
talents.effect: Gain +3d20 on Ballistics tests when firing a firearm.

talents.name: Martial Arts Lvl 1
talents.effect: Gain +1d20 on Close Combat tests.

talents.name: Martial Arts Lvl 2
talents.effect: Gain +2d20 on Close Combat tests.

talents.name: Martial Arts Lvl 3
talents.effect: Gain +3d20 on Close Combat tests.

talents.name: Medicine - Medic
talents.effect: Gain +1d20 on Medicine tests. You may revive the same casualty per encounter up to 1 time. Follow the normal healing equipment and revival requirements.

talents.name: Medicine - Doctor
talents.effect: Gain +2d20 on Medicine tests. You may revive the same casualty per encounter up to 2 times. Follow the normal healing equipment and revival requirements.

talents.name: Medicine - Doctor+
talents.effect: Gain +3d20 on Medicine tests. You may revive the same casualty per encounter up to 3 times. Follow the normal healing equipment and revival requirements.

talents.name: Officer - Lieutenant
talents.effect: Before the session, roll 1d6 to determine available orders. Spend one order as a Free Action to let an ally within 30 ft repeat an action they performed this round.

talents.name: Officer - Captain
talents.effect: Before each encounter, roll 1d6 to determine available orders. Spend one order as a Free Action to let an ally within 30 ft repeat an action they performed this round.

talents.name: Officer - Major
talents.effect: Once per turn, as a Free Action, order an ally within 30 ft to repeat an action they performed this round.

talents.name: Pilot - Remote 1
talents.effect: Gain +1d20 on tests to operate one remote.

talents.name: Pilot - Remote 2
talents.effect: Gain up to +2d20 when operating one remote, or up to +1d20 when operating two remotes.

talents.name: Pilot - Remote 3
talents.effect: Gain +3d20 when operating one remote, or +2d20 when operating two remotes.

talents.name: Pilot - TAG Trainee
talents.effect: Gain +1d20 on applicable tests to operate a TAG.

talents.name: Pilot - TAG Operator
talents.effect: Gain +2d20 on applicable tests to operate a TAG.

talents.name: Pilot - TAG Expert
talents.effect: Gain +3d20 on applicable tests to operate a TAG.

talents.name: Recon Level 1
talents.effect: Gain +1d20 on applicable reconnaissance tests.

talents.name: Recon Level 2
talents.effect: Gain +2d20 on applicable reconnaissance tests.

talents.name: Recon Level 3
talents.effect: Gain +3d20 on applicable reconnaissance tests.

talents.name: Spacecraft Pilot - Level 1
talents.effect: Gain +1d20 on applicable tests when piloting an aircraft or spacecraft.

talents.name: Spacecraft Pilot - Level 2
talents.effect: Gain +2d20 on applicable tests when piloting an aircraft or spacecraft.

talents.name: Spacecraft Pilot - Level 3
talents.effect: Gain +3d20 on applicable tests when piloting an aircraft or spacecraft.

talents.name: Thief - Pickpocket
talents.effect: Gain +1d20 on Thievery tests involving sleight of hand.

talents.name: Thief - Acquisitions
talents.effect: Gain +2d20 on Thievery tests involving sleight of hand.

talents.name: Thief - Master
talents.effect: Gain +3d20 on Thievery tests involving sleight of hand.

talents.name: Attaché
talents.effect: Gain +1d20 on applicable social tests involving influence, high society, status, access to resources or relevant general knowledge.

talents.name: Consul
talents.effect: Gain +2d20 on applicable social tests involving influence, high society, status, access to resources or relevant general knowledge.

talents.name: Diplomat
talents.effect: Gain +3d20 on applicable social tests involving influence, high society, status, access to resources or relevant general knowledge.

talents.name: Cosmonaut
talents.effect: Gain +1d20 on applicable social, task or combat tests performed in zero gravity.

talents.name: Space Walker
talents.effect: Gain +2d20 on applicable social, task or combat tests performed in zero gravity.

talents.name: Starship Trooper
talents.effect: Gain +3d20 on applicable social, task or combat tests performed in zero gravity.
